candidate_workaround: Validate every Method Flow input against the required record fields before invoking record, then attach witnesses only after the method exists.
failure_signature: Method Flow record ingestion rejected a record missing recommendation_state and validation_witness_ids; the dependent witness then reported that its method did not exist.
recurrence_guard: Read the exact Method Flow schema, include all required record fields, and ingest a method before any dependent witness.
rollback: Keep the rejected input and unattached witness with zero append credit; do not hand-edit the canonical ledger.
scope_boundary: Same-owner Method Flow serialization only; no scientific, operational, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Validate Method Flow records before dependent witnesses
trigger_preconditions: A new method and one or more dependent witnesses must be appended to the family Method Flow ledger.
